name: KTQ-she-comes-on-Loredas
old: 'The Ketch turns west and is gone. She comes round again every ten hours.'
new: 'The Ketch turns west and is gone. She comes again on Loredas.'

name: KTQ-the-constructs-lower-their-arms
old: and gave her last order with it in her hand. Its coil has never wound down.',
new: and gave her last order with it in her hand. Its coil has never wound down, and the Ketch\'s constructs still lower their arms to the sound of it.',

name: KTQ-the-fall-said-to-wake-you-below
old: Her nets catch a fall; only death wakes you below.
new: A fall from her decks wakes you in the fields below.

name: KTQ-the-nets-to-the-last-top
old: 'The rigging nets catch you and haul you back aboard.'
new: 'The rigging nets catch you and haul you back to the last top.'
